sources.title: Technical Discipline: Artificial Intelligence – Machine Learning
sources.inspection_scope: Captured the complete public FAA page, last updated 2026-04-09. Inspected its description of the FAA AI/ML technical discipline, certification-framework focus, and collaboration with industry, government, standards-development organizations and academia.

regions.locator: FAA page, main text and update stamp
regions.excerpt: international collaboration with industry, other government agencies, standards development organizations, and academic institutions

sources.limitations: This current program page describes FAA research and policy-support activity. It is not a rule, accepted means of compliance, consensus-standard publication, certification basis, or evidence that an applicant has shown a high-criticality learned component is safe.

sources.title: EASA Comment-Response Tool listing for RMT.0742 / NPA 2025-07
sources.inspection_scope: Captured the complete EASA CRT document-list page. Inspected the RMT.0742 rows, which label NPA 2025-07(B) as proposed DS.AI detailed specifications / AMC / GM, display a 2026-03-10 comment deadline, and use the page's defined status icon 'Document is awaiting responses to comments'.

regions.locator: HTML table row trDoc30_1133; status legend and RMT.0742 row
regions.excerpt: Document is awaiting responses to comments ... Proposed detailed specifications and associated acceptable means of compliance and guidance material for AI trustworthiness (DS.AI)

sources.limitations: The status is a time-sensitive website observation. This document-list page establishes neither the substance of DS.AI nor the status of any private certification project. It must not override an EASA final decision, CRD, AMC/GM publication, or later rulemaking page if one appears.

sources.title: 49 U.S.C. § 30115 — Certification of compliance
sources.publisher: Office of the Law Revision Counsel, U.S. House of Representatives
sources.inspection_scope: Captured the complete current preliminary U.S. Code page, which states that its text contains laws in effect on 2026-09-21. Inspected subsection (a), including the certification duty, reasonable-care qualification, and false-or-misleading limitation.

regions.excerpt: shall certify ... complies with applicable motor vehicle safety standards ... exercising reasonable care

sources.limitations: Section 30115 addresses certification of compliance with applicable federal motor-vehicle safety standards. It does not create a general federal pre-market approval of an autonomous-driving system, prescribe an ML development process, state that all hazards are covered by FMVSS, or decide state operating authority.

sources.title: NHTSA interpretation: automatic activation of hazard warning signal for nonresponsive driver
sources.inspection_scope: Inspected the complete NHTSA public interpretation through an accessible browser rendering. Direct snapshot retrieval returned HTTP 403. The page says NHTSA does not pre-approve new vehicles, equipment or ADS technologies; it describes the applicable-FMVSS and safety-defect conditions and manufacturer self-certification. It also states that the interpretation itself is nonbinding.

regions.excerpt: NHTSA does not pre-approve new motor vehicles ... The Safety Act requires manufacturers to self-certify

sources.limitations: This is a nonbinding interpretation of a specific lighting/ADAS question, not an autonomous-vehicle approval, a blanket permission to deploy, or an ML assurance standard. The full original HTML was unavailable to the project snapshot tool and needs a renewed capture before release use.

sources.title: SAE J3321_202603 — Verification and Validation of AI/ML-Based Systems in Ground Vehicles
sources.inspection_scope: Inspected the complete public SAE Mobilus product page through an accessible browser rendering. The page lists the document as new on 2026-03-16 and describes broad AI/ML lifecycle coverage, but expressly calls it an information report with no mandatory requirements and says its V&V methods are general. Direct snapshot retrieval timed out.

regions.locator: SAE public product page, Scope / Content
regions.excerpt: The document is an information report with no mandatory requirements.

sources.limitations: The public product page is not the licensed document text. The wording establishes published public scope and status only; it does not establish clause-level requirements, a conformance scheme, regulatory recognition, or a particular vehicle's safety case. Reacquire a lawful complete copy or authorized excerpt before release-grade use.
